validation.scope_note: Structural/script-shape validation only; it does not independently authenticate lexical claims.

notes: The Fāṭima family (فاطمة, root f-ṭ-m 'to wean, abstain') had source glosses such as 'The Opener, Supporter' and 'Abundance, Wealth'; these are replaced by the source-supported lexical sense.
The f-w-z family (fawz/fawaz/fawzi/fawzia and variants) is glossed from fawz ('victory, triumph') instead of the source glosses 'Tranquil, Peaceful, Calm' and 'Intelligent, Wise, Bright'.
The f-y-ḍ family (fayyad/fayyadh/fayyaz/fayaaz/fayaz/fayad) is glossed 'Abundantly generous; overflowing' instead of 'Servant, Helper, Supporter' and similar.
The faḍl family (fazal/fazl/fazeel/fazeela/fazil/fazila/fazilat/fazli/fazloon) is glossed from faḍl ('grace, bounty, excellence').
Truncated compounds (fathul, fazlur) and forms that could not be matched to a lexical source (faudel, fay, fayona, faza, fazan, fazar, fazia, feray) carry no asserted meaning.
